_doc: Bosch Rexroth strut profile 40x40L: 40 x 40 mm with the 10 mm slot, anodised. Dimensions and section figures are from the MGE 14.0 catalogue, which prints them to 0.1 cm² and 0.1 cm⁴: on a section this small that is a step of several percent. The drawn outline leaves out the true shape of the corner hollows (drawn as squares of about the same area), the bore's square form with its notches (drawn round, some 25 mm² less open) and the steps that thin each lip toward the opening, so it comes out about a tenth heavier than the catalogue's figures.
name: profile-4040-bosch-l
